Citi Strata Elite℠ cardmembers have access to coveted dining experiences with The Supper Club® with tickets available for purchase to events hosted in major U.S. cities. Citi Strata Elite℠ cardholders can learn everything about cocktails, from drink-making fundamentals to advanced techniques. Complimentary access is granted by enrolling with a Citi Strata Elite℠ Card. For Adults 21+.2

Citi Entertainment® is an entertainment access program available to eligible Citi® credit card and Citibank® Debit Card customers. Citi cardmembers get special access to purchase tickets to thousands of events, including presale tickets and exclusive experiences to the year's most anticipated concerts, sporting events, arts and culture experiences.
